text: おれい　っちゅーのも　なんやけど…　これ　やるわ！

structure.jp: おれい　っちゅーのも　なんやけど…
structure.en: calling it a thank-you is a bit much, but...

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.span: おれい　っちゅーのも
patterns.explanation: っちゅー is the Kansai dialect form of という, 'called'. おれい　っちゅーのも = 'calling it a thank-you'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど means 'but' and softens what was just said. なんや here is a vague 'is a bit, you know'. なんやけど = 'is a bit much, but'.
